signal: Filevine launched its LOIS console (June 2026), AI that runs the modern law firm, after raising $400M and acquiring Pincites.

email.body1:
Tess, saw Filevine launched the LOIS console and raised $400M to scale its AI legal platform.

A launch and raise like that usually open more government and corporate accounts than the team can cover before reps reach them all, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tess, quick follow-up for Filevine.

With LOIS expanding the enterprise story, targets for government and corporate usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tess, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your team's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tess, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a LOIS launch plus a fresh raise keeps a team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your government and corporate motion? I will tailor it to Filevine either way.
